diagnosis.nativeMemoryPreference: Native Kickstart 1.3 returns A501 addresses C04AD0/C04AF0 for ANY/PUBLIC, and Chip 59E8 for CHIP. Bootstrap banks initially have priority zero. Standalone native finalization gives CPU-only banks priority one and re-enqueues them, preserving any explicit nonzero priority. Native regression checks both ANY and PUBLIC in A501; explicit CHIP still stays in Chip.
diagnosis.lowMemoryCorruption: Picture data replacing address four and I/O to $1FC followed failed Chip allocations, rather than valid low-page allocations.
diagnosis.stackEvidenceLimit: The traced startup live span was 638 bytes. Crack-intro writes $60000..$72BB4 are not a stack watermark. Bounded native/media tests do not prove every possible stack depth.
diagnosis.artePoolFailure: The 128 KiB private A501 arena left only about 370 KiB in the loader pool before its 470000-byte request. Packing native private state into 28 KiB restores sufficient contiguous A501 memory.
diagnosis.missingInterrupts: VERTB/EXTER server nodes existed while INTENA and CPU autovectors were zero. The actual-ROM VBlank probe failed with callback count zero before native delivery.

limitations: Bounded media and partial graphics.library coverage, not full AmigaOS support.
The retained graphics signal-based WaitTOF task owner and complete interrupt-exit task rescheduling remain unqualified.
